rca:flags.text: Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (13084 scans, 9967 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Niskin 15 (SA-417, ~83 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle -0.0179 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.003 PSU/m.
Niskin 15 (SA-417, ~83 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.0228 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.003 PSU/m.
Autosal workbook header date is 2025-04-20 but the cast is on 2025-08-18; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
Autosal workbook Sheet1!B9 says '2024 Salts'; cruise year is 2025 (not changed).

OOI annotation 6636 (suspect; 2025-08-08 15:40:00 to open) covers 24239 of the samples used: Calibration CTD cast and discrete sample verification data indicate that oxygen values recorded by this sensor are anomalously low for this deployment. Use O2 data with caution.
